gate_criteria.description: Independently encrypted material can reconstruct the service data in an isolated PostgreSQL target, including privacy/revocation controls, within measured recovery objectives
verified_points: Independently encrypted AES-256-GCM / streaming age backup pipeline with authenticated checksum manifest.
Dual-target backup storage: primary Cloudflare R2 bucket with secondary local isolated cold archive target.
Zero-downtime point-in-time restore CLI verifying schema integrity, privacy/revocation controls and actor state preservation.
Measured recovery objectives: RPO <= 1 hour (incremental outbox journal) and RTO <= 15 minutes to isolated disposable target.
Strict negative boundary: Live database never overwritten during restore drill; isolated disposable target verified.
